verdicts.read: Plan payer back to losses: NM=-2.6%, OM=-2.8%, EPS growth FY25=-315% on rev +19%. Survival not the issue: P/FCF=3.9, D/E=0.71. Turnaround unproven; cost-fix evidence unserved.
Thin-margin distributor (NM=0.7%) at PE=35.4 vs EPS +12% FY26, rev +14%: PEG~2.9 >2 (C8). Equity negative (P/B=-21.1, D/E=-3.45) so C12 unreadable. Story fine, price full.
Mega-cap fast grower: rev +45% FY25, EPS +96%, NM=33.5%, PE=42.9 -> PEG~0.45 on FY25 EPS. Caveat: growth >30% is C17 unsustainable flag; mcap=1.21T is late innings; P/FCF=60.3.
Exchange stalwart: NM=63.1%, D/E=0.13, DY=3.83%, EPS +15%/+9%/+20%. PE=24.9 -> PEG~1.7, yield-adj PEG~0.8 (<1.0 poor, C9). Quality high, valuation full.
Hotel REIT, earnings negative: PE=-20.2, NM=-6.4%, GM=-7.5%, rev -2%/-4% FY25/24, D/E=1.33 (>50% debt, C12). DY=6.04% is the only prop; payout cover unserved.
Loss-making insurer/tech: PE=-148.3, NM=-1.1%, negative equity (P/B=-166.8, D/E=-34.2), beta=3.16. Rev +10% FY25. Balance sheet fails survival test (C5 turnaround).
P&C insurer at PE=10.2 on EPS +28% FY25/+68% FY24, NM=17.0%, D/E=0.34, P/FCF=7.7 (FCF yield ~13%, C13 terrific). PEG well <1. Underwriting-cycle risk is the roadblock.
Hotel REIT, rev flat (+2%/yr x3), EPS -131% FY25, PE=-30.9, NM=-3.1%, D/E=1.02, DY=0.19%. No earnings, no yield: nothing for a Lynch long to rest on.
Bottler (EUR): rev +2% FY25, EPS +33% after -15% FY24, PE=22.8, NM=9.3%, D/E=1.47 (>50% debt), DY=2.0%. PEG~2 on 3y avg EPS ~9%. Steady, not cheap.
Hotel REIT: rev -1% FY25, EPS +144% after -50% (rebound off low base), PE=18.9, D/E=0.79, DY=3.26%. Cyclical recovery story; RevPAR/industry data unserved.
Payroll stalwart: rev +7%/yr x3, EPS +9-11%, NM=20.1%, PE=26.7 -> PEG~2.7 >2 (C8); yield-adj (10+2.3)/26.7=0.46 poor (C9). Quality fine, price full.
Hotel REIT: D/E=0.04 clean, DY=5.39%, PE=24.1, but rev -1% and EPS -17% FY25. Balance sheet supports; growth does not. Slow-grower-like yield play.
Hotel REIT: EPS -70% FY25, -85% FY24, PE=50.3, GM=2.4%, NM=5.3%. Two years of falling earnings at a 50x multiple; DY=2.9%. Fundamentals do not support.
Regulated utility: rev +9%, EPS +19% FY25, PE=21.9, DY=2.99%, D/E=1.66 (>50% debt). Yield-adj PEG~0.8 (3y EPS ~15%). P/FCF=7.7 positive. Fair, not a bargain.
Compounder: rev +16/12/13%, EPS +19/17/16%, NM=46.3%, PE=34.1 -> PEG~1.9. P/B=97.5, D/E=4.39 reflect buybacks. Superb business, valuation near C8 red line.
Life insurer: PE=19.3, P/FCF=3.9, DY=2.29%, D/E=0.78, but EPS erratic (-20%/+229%/-71%), NM=4.6%. Cheap on cash flow, no steady earnings line.
Pharma stalwart with EPS -1%/-12%/-59% over 3y, PE=81.4, negative equity (P/B=-86.2, D/E=-11.9). DY=2.39%. Earnings trend and balance sheet contradict.
Small-cap software: rev +27/22/17% (accelerating), NM=15.3%, D/E=0.04, PE=45.6 -> PEG~1.7 on rev. Early-innings fast grower; valuation full, FCF yield ~3% (P/FCF=32).
Just profitable: rev +15/18/11%, NM=6.8%, OM=5.2%, PE=65.7, D/E=0.17, beta=2.05. Earnings line too new for PEG; story is margin expansion, unproven.
Net-lease REIT: DY=5.76%, D/E=0.07, NM=22.3%, PE=41.1; rev +9%, EPS +19% after -22%/-11%. Slow grower judged on yield; payout ratio and FFO unserved.
Tower REIT: rev -35% FY25, negative equity (P/B=-10.7, D/E=-7.16), EPS -360% FY24. DY=5.24%. Shrinking with a broken balance sheet (C12).
Shrinking software: rev -5%/-5%, PE=6.6, P/FCF=4.1 (FCF yield ~24%, C13 outstanding), D/E=0.17. Cheap cash machine with no growth; catalyst unserved.
Rev +51% FY25, +33% FY24, NM=15.1%, D/E=0.02, PE=79.8. Growth >30% = C17 unsustainable flag; FY25 EPS growth=-3473% is a sign-flip artifact. Story strong, price high.
Cinema operator: rev +2%/-1% after +25%, EPS -54% FY25, PE=21.6, D/E=0.93, DY=0.9%. Recovery has stalled; industry data unserved.
Midstream: rev +12%, EPS +17%/+10%, PE=21.5, DY=3.52%, D/E=1.02 (~50% debt). Yield-adj PEG~0.8. Steady fee story; leverage at C12 line.
Instruments: rev +7%/-5%/0%, EPS +3%/+5%/+1%, PE=34.0 -> PEG >10. Clean balance sheet (D/E=0.54) but no growth to justify the multiple.
Utility: PE=21.5, DY=3.09%, EPS +17% FY25, D/E=1.61. P/FCF=-68.1: negative FCF, CapEx-heavy (C13/C16 fail). Yield story funded by debt.
Utility: PE=20.2, DY=3.29%, EPS +6/11/6%, D/E=1.97 (~66% debt, C12 high). P/FCF=-11.2: negative FCF (C13 fail). Defensive yield, weak cash.
Software stalwart: rev +10/9/11%, EPS +22% FY26, NM=22.0%, PE=22.0 -> PEG~1.0; P/FCF=13.2 (FCF yield ~7.6%). D/E=1.09 watch. Reasonable price for steady growth.
Retail REIT: DY=4.61%, PE=25.8, D/E=0.85, rev +5%, EPS +51% after -46%. Yield-led slow grower; FFO and payout unserved.
Pipeline (CAD): DY=4.01%, PE=26.1, EPS -26% FY25, D/E=2.3 (~70% debt, C12 high leverage). Rev +10%. Yield carries it; leverage is the roadblock.
Retail REIT: DY=4.13%, PE=20.7, NM=38.2%, D/E=0.8, EPS +34% FY25, rev +3%. Sound yield play; FFO/payout unserved.
Healthcare REIT: rev +18% FY25, EPS +175% off tiny base, PE=157.3, NM=4.1%, DY=2.36%. GAAP PE unreadable for REIT; FFO and asset value unserved.
Unprofitable SaaS: rev +33->26->24% (decelerating, C17), NM=-13.6%, PE=-44.2, P/FCF=61.9 (FCF yield ~1.6%, C13 fail). No earnings to compound.
Insurer at PE=12.9, NM=26.9%, D/E=0.29, DY=2.0%, but rev -9% and EPS -29% FY25. Cheap and sound; FY25 earnings decline needs a reason (unserved).
Devices: rev +12%, EPS -74% FY25 (after +202% one-off), PE=50.7 -> PEG >4 on rev. D/E=0.07 clean. Multiple ahead of earnings.
Beverages: rev +8/4/5%, NM=7.1%, PE=34.8 -> PEG >2 (C8), D/E=1.37. Yield-adj PEG ~0.5 poor (C9). Slow business at a growth multiple.
Household products: rev +2/4/9% slowing, EPS +27/-23/+82 erratic, PE=34.0, DY=1.15%. Yield-adj PEG <1 (C9). Stalwart priced like a grower.
Household products: rev +1%, EPS -25% FY25, PE=37.2, P/B=319.1, D/E=33.3 (near-zero equity, C12 fail). DY=2.23%. Shrinking earnings at a premium.
PE=2.5 but NM=42.3% vs OM=-1.8%: earnings are non-operating (cause unserved). Rev +9%/+31%, P/FCF=5.7 (FCF yield ~17.5%), D/E=0.39. Cash says yes, PE misleads.
Rev +13/20/13%, NM=25.5%, D/E=0.01, PE=37.5, EPS -12% FY26. ret_12m=-50.64%: C22 down-25 buy only if story intact, unverifiable here. Growth slowing.
Shrinking mailer: rev -7/-3/-41%, negative equity (P/B=-2.7, D/E=-2.5), PE=14.2, P/FCF=5.7 (FCF yield ~17.5%), DY=2.19%. Cash flow funds survival; balance sheet fails C12.
Stalwart: rev +2/3/6%, EPS +23/0/13% (3y avg ~12%), PE=28.1 -> PEG~2.3 >2 (C8); yield-adj ~0.5 (C9 poor). Great business, full price.
E&P: PE=9.5, D/E=0.35, P/FCF=11.8; EPS -35/-39/-69% and rev -2/-22/-22% over 3y. Low PE on falling earnings: cyclical trough or not unknown; commodity trend unserved.
Insurance broker: rev +10/8/10%, EPS +3/9/24% decelerating, PE=22.8, DY=1.98%, D/E=1.52 (>50% debt). Steady, fully valued.
Regional bank: PE=11.9, NM=32.4%, D/E=0.15, DY=2.93%, EPS +20/4/24%. Yield-adj PEG (16+2.9)/11.9~1.6 passes (C9). Rev -5% FY25 is the watch item.
Unprofitable SaaS: rev +31->26->24% decelerating, NM=-12.1%, PE=-58.9, P/FCF=60.9 (FCF yield ~1.6%, C13 fail). beta=0.025 implausible (short history?).
Regional bank: PE=7.9, P/FCF=4.6, NM=23.5%, EPS +23/14%, DY=2.83%. Yield-adj PEG ~2.6 fabulous (C9). Bank funding/credit quality (C15) unserved.
Construction materials: rev +12/11%, EPS +121% after -41/-36%, PE=14.7, D/E=0.48, P/FCF=53.6 (FCF yield ~1.9%, C13/C16 CapEx-heavy).
Engineering: rev +5% FY25 after +15/59%, EPS -25%, PE=20.9, D/E=0.55, NM=8.6%. Growth slowing sharply; fair price, story needs a reason.
Exchange/data: rev +11/22%, EPS +61% FY25 after -8/-8%, PE=27.3, D/E=0.77, DY=1.22%. PEG~1.4 on 3y; fully valued stalwart.
Pharma: rev +1/7/1%, TTM PE=117.7, NM=4.8% (depressed TTM earnings, cause unserved), P/FCF=22.8 (FCF yield ~4.4% <5%, C13). ret_12m=74.9% has outrun earnings.
Rev +22->15->12% decelerating (C17 sell signal), PE=114.8, NM=9.6%, P/FCF=33.4 (FCF yield ~3%). EPS +688% is base effect. Multiple prices growth that is fading.
Held. Losses: NM=-19.9%, OM=-33.1%, GM=-4.6%, P/FCF=-13.8 (cash burn). Rev +10% FY25 after -20/-52%. D/E=0.48. C22 down-buy needs verified intact story; cash unserved.

findings.claim: Room is mostly stalwarts/slow growers (approx 30 of 54); genuine profitable fast growers are few: LLY, AVPT, HNGE, DOCS. Lynch's tenbagger engine (C19) is thin; much of the room is defensive multiple expansion.
findings.evidence: category count from verdicts; growth_3y per name

findings.claim: Several stalwarts sit above PEG 2 on 3y EPS growth (C8 red flag): CAH ~2.9, ADP ~2.7, KO ~2.3, KDP, CHD, A, EW. Price momentum here is multiple expansion, not earnings compounding.
findings.evidence: PE TTM / avg growth_3y EPS: ADP PE=26.7 EPS~10%; KO PE=28.1 EPS~12%; A PE=34.0 EPS~3%

findings.claim: Five hotel REITs in the room (PK, PEB, DRH, APLE, SHO): one cyclical bet. Revenue flat to down (-2%..+6% FY25); PK, PEB negative earnings, SHO EPS -70% FY25. Fundamentals do not show an industry upturn.
findings.evidence: PK NM=-6.4%; PEB EPS -131%; SHO EPS -70%; APLE rev -1%; DRH rev -1%

findings.claim: Negative or near-zero equity makes C12 and P/B unreadable on CAH, PRCH, ABBV, CCI, PBI (P/B<0) and CL (P/B=319, D/E=33.3). D/E>1 (debt >50% of capital, C12 high leverage) on LLY, PK, CCEP, AEP, MA, LNT, CMS, CRM, TRP, KDP, MRSH, MRK, KO, KMI.
Fast-grower sell signals (C17): growth decelerating at BRZE 33->26->24%, TTAN 31->26->24%, OKTA 22->15->12%; growth above 30% (unsustainable) at LLY rev +45%, HNGE rev +51%.

C13 FCF-yield fails (<5% or negative): LNT P/FCF=-68.1, CMS -11.2, MP -13.8 (negative FCF); BRZE 61.9, TTAN 60.9, LLY 60.3, ACA 53.6, OKTA 33.4, MRK 22.8 (~4.4%). Strongest cash yields: TDC 4.1, CNC 3.9, MET 3.9, ZION 4.6, LYFT 5.7, PBI 5.7.

C23: 2026-10-21 sits in the Oct-Dec tax-loss window. Room names below their SMA: MP -22.86, O -3.6, ZION -2.32, VTR -1.76, REG -1.22, TTEK -0.73, KIM -0.63, HOMB -0.46. Context only, never a nomination; 'sound company' must be verified.

EPS growth sign-flip artifacts are unreadable as growth rates: HNGE -3473%, LYFT +12324%, MRK +4729%, CRM +1924%, PBI +1300%, OKTA +688%. TTAN beta=0.0245 implausible. PEG here uses 3y avg EPS growth as LT-growth proxy; LT growth not served.

CCEP reports EUR, TRP CAD: ratios are unit-free and comparable; marketCap/EPS levels are not compared across currencies. Fiscal years differ (CAH/ADP Jun, CRM/BRZE/TTAN Jan, A Oct, TTEK Sep, DOCS Mar).

Held; fundamentals contradict a long: NM=-19.9%, OM=-33.1%, negative FCF (P/FCF=-13.8), sma -22.86. C22 makes down-big a buy ONLY with a verified intact story; cash/net-cash, survival liquidity and the business story are unserved, so verification goes to the PM. No comment on stop (house law).
PE=2.5 rests on NM=42.3% while OM=-1.8%: net income is non-operating. The P/E is not a Lynch bargain signal; FCF yield ~17.5% (P/FCF=5.7) is the honest cash read.
Top-tallied name (3 seats) is a turnaround in Lynch terms, not a grower: FY25 EPS -315% with NM=-2.6%. Supportive: P/FCF=3.9, D/E=0.71. Proof of cost repair is unserved.
